about: Closed list of third-party companion skills this catalog measured. An entry needs a measurement; a skill without evidence does not enter. This is internal organization of the catalog this repo owns, not the open template/stack selection registry excluded by issue #9.

scopeLegend.global: Makes sense in any host repo (searching, browsing, orchestration).
scopeLegend.project: Only makes sense when the repo carries the matching signals.

signalKindLegend.files: Glob matched against tracked files anywhere in the repo; `**/` matches nested paths, so `**/*.odcs.yaml` catches `data/orders.odcs.yaml` as well as a root file.
signalKindLegend.directories: Directory path that must exist in the repo.
signalKindLegend.dependencies: Dependency name declared in the repo's manifest (package.json, pyproject.toml, requirements).
